Name: Universally Loved Diamonds
Author: PeeingOnMyPoopy
Description:
Makes diamonds a universally loved gift. Because, I don't know about you, but if someone gifted me a diamond the size of my head, I'm not going to go, "Oh, thanks." or "That's cool", I'm going to love it.

Note: Requires SMAPI and Content Patcher
